evidence.ACL: Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the ACL without ligament injury.
evidence.MCL: the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: The medial meniscus demonstrates intrasubstance degeneration without a well-defined linear tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with maceration and degenerative tearing of the lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: There are moderate degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments
evidence.Lateral OA: There are severe degenerative changes in the lateral compartment with full-thickness cartilage loss at and subchondral reactive changes.
evidence.PF OA: moderate degenerative changes in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with high-grade cartilage thinning involving the lateral patellar facet and lateral aspect of femoral trochlea.
evidence.Effusion: There is a large knee joint effusion with synovitis.
evidence.Synovitis: There is a large knee joint effusion with synovitis.
